sequentialthinking.rationale: `sequentialthinking` is the only registered tool (`server.registerTool` at dist/index.js:24). Its handler simply calls `thinkingServer.processThought(args)` (dist/index.js:105) on an in-process `SequentialThinkingServer` instance (dist/index.js:23) and returns the parsed JSON (dist/index.js:110-113). The declared `outputSchema` (dist/index.js:97-103) returns only bookkeeping counters (`thoughtNumber`, `totalThoughts`, `nextThoughtNeeded`, `branches`, `thoughtHistoryLength`) — no file, database, or credentialed data (no SECRET), no attacker-controlled fetch or external content ingestion (no UNTRUSTED), no outbound request/write to any agent-chosen destination (no SINK), and no process spawning or eval (no HOSTEXEC). Transport is stdio only (dist/index.js:117) and the only side-effect visible in this source is `console.error` diagnostics (dist/index.js:119). `dist/lib.js`, which contains `processThought`, was not included in the provided source, so the in-memory-only behaviour is inferred from the handler's schema and usage.
